name: Google Health API Data Types 2026
methodology: Every data type in Google's Google Health API data-types table (https://developers.google.com/health/data-types), read on 2026-10-17, joined to the v4 discovery document (https://health.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v4, revision 20261014). Name, dataType id, filter parameter, record type, storage resolution, the webhook and true-zeros badges, the v4beta tag, operations, scopes and compatible devices are copied from Google's table; field names and rollup fields from the discovery document's schemas; the Fitbit Web API predecessor from Google's migration mapping table. Three columns are DERIVED and keep their evidence: scopes are the prefix Google's Scopes page states plus the suffix the table prints; methods pair each table operation with the discovery document's method (case-insensitively, and "update" with patch only because Google's endpoint-mapping table maps updates to patch); dataPointProperty is the DataPoint field whose description names the type (dataPointEvidence, verbatim) or, where that description names none, the field DataPoint.name's kebab-case rule picks (dataPointMatch says which). flags lists the kinds of disagreement found between Google's own pages for the type; the pages show each one with the texts that disagree.
generatedFrom: src/data/googleHealthApi.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-google-health-api.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.dataType: The hyphenated id Google uses in endpoint URLs
fields.filterParam: The underscored id Google uses as the dataType filter value
fields.recordType: Interval, Sample, Daily, Session or Food, as Google's table prints it
fields.storageResolution: Google's storage resolution; null where the table states none
fields.channel: v4, or v4beta where Google's table tags the row
fields.webhookSupport: yes where Google's table shows the Webhook support badge
fields.trueZerosSupport: yes where Google's table shows the True zeros support badge
fields.operations: The operations Google's table lists, semicolon-separated
fields.methods: DERIVED: the users.dataTypes.dataPoints methods those operations map to
fields.scopes: DERIVED: full scope URLs (Google's documented prefix + the printed suffix)
fields.dataPointProperty: DERIVED: the DataPoint field for the type; null where neither discovery document has one
fields.dataPointMatch: How dataPointProperty was matched: description or kebab-case rule
fields.dataPointEvidence: That field's description in the discovery document, verbatim
fields.schema: The discovery document schema the DataPoint field refers to
fields.rollupSchema: The *RollupValue schema a rollup of the type returns, where the table lists rollup or dailyRollup
fields.fitbitPredecessor: The Fitbit Web API data type Google's mapping table maps to this type; null where it has no row
fields.flags: Kinds of disagreement between Google's own pages for this type
fields.googleDocs: Google's REST reference anchor for the type
fields.page: This site's page for the data type
